summary: Quiet residential kerb beside a kindergarten and dental clinic; steep and homes opposite.

best_section.where: Rylatt Street west kerb, just in from the main road beside the kindergarten

drivers.seclusion: West side backs onto a kindergarten and dental clinic, no dwelling mapped within 25 m of 5-30 m; homes opposite on the east side and a block of flats near the corner.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parked car and kerbside room; light van fits.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street just off a busy arterial, some noise at the corner.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; 2P signs apply Mon-Fri 9-5 only, No Stopping near the corner.

flags: Steep: about 6% here, 10% over the whole stretch
Noise from the arterial at the top
No Stopping sign near the corner
sun_shade: Mostly open, some tree shade from the west side.
